modules.name: Phona
modules.description: Physical-model singing voice: vocal folds and vocal tract, with an external input (talk box)

modules.name: Phona Lab
modules.description: Tuning tool for Phona's sung consonants: put it next to a Phona, turn the knobs, copy the values

modules.name: Phona View
modules.description: Animated mouth and throat: put it next to a Phona (or its Phona Lab) to see the voice's vocal tract, airflow and vocal folds

modules.name: Phona Scope
modules.description: Instrument display: put it next to a Phona (or its other expanders) to see the voice's spectrum, formants, tract area, glottal waveform and vowel chart
